items.item: The page header has a plural title ("Stock movements") and at most one primary action; other actions such as export sit in a secondary position
items.evidence: h1 "Stock movements"; header has filled indigo "New adjustment" and outlined secondary "Export CSV"; audit headerPrimaryActions=1.

items.item: The movements table appears in the first viewport, with search and 2–3 visible filters (movement type, warehouse, date range) and no decorative hero above it
items.evidence: Table header at y=374 with rows visible in the 1440x900 screenshot; #q search, #fType, #fWh, #fFrom/#fTo present. Only a plain 4-card summary row sits above, no hero (audit table-above-fold not violated).

items.item: Movement type is shown as a text label combined with an icon or shape, not by colour alone, and the set of types is limited to receipt, issue, transfer and adjustment
items.evidence: badge() renders only a coloured text pill (TYPE_STYLE emerald/amber/sky/violet) with no icon or type-specific shape. The text label means it is not colour-only, but there is no icon or distinguishing shape. The types are limited to the 4 required.

items.item: Quantity changes carry an explicit + or − sign, are right-aligned with tabular figures, and the unit of measure is in the column header or a separate unit column, not repeated inside cells
items.evidence: Sign and alignment are fine (`${r.qty > 0 ? '+' : '−'}`, td class `text-right num`). But the unit is repeated in every cell: `${r.uom}`, and the header is just "Quantity". The unit span is also 2.56:1 contrast.

items.item: A transfer row shows both the source and destination warehouse, and each row has a human-readable document number plus an absolute date and time
items.evidence: whCell for Transfer is `DC-DAL → DC-ATL` (codes, not names). Each row has a Reference such as TR-7950 / PO- / SO- / ADJ- and a Movement ID MV-200104, plus "Nov 4, 2026 / 05:42 PM" via fmtDate/fmtTime.

items.item: A running balance or resulting on-hand quantity column is available so users can reconcile each movement
items.evidence: COLS has no balance column (date, id, type, item, wh, qty, ref, status). `balance` exists only in the detail drawer as "Balance after", which is not a column in the table.

items.item: The table is sorted by date, newest first, by default, with `aria-sort` on the sorted header and pagination at the bottom with a page-size control
items.evidence: state={sort:'date',dir:-1}; th gets aria-sort="descending" for the active column; the screenshot shows Nov 4 first. #pageSize (10/15/25/50) plus Previous/Next and #pageInfo sit below the table.

items.item: A filter combination with no matches shows a no-results state with a clear-filters action, distinct from the first-use empty state; a loading skeleton and an error state with retry are also present
items.evidence: #empty "No movements match these filters" with #emptyReset is present. There is no first-use empty state, no loading skeleton (audit loadingPlaceholders=0) and no error or retry state in the markup or script.

items.item: Icon-only controls have accessible names, interactive targets are at least 24×24px, and text and status contrast meets 4.5:1
items.evidence: #dClose has aria-label="Close details" and audit smallTargets=0. But audit text-contrast reports 21 violations: sidebar footer 3.75:1, the unit spans `text-slate-400` 2.56:1, and the transfer arrow in text-slate-400.

notes: Audit score 72. Layout is clean and conventional: no gradient, glass, emoji, avatar, hover-lift or oversized radius (radii 4-8px). The four summary cards have no icons and no delta pills, so I did not call them kpi-icon-tiles, though they are a generic KPI row. Main gaps: no balance column (balance appears only in the drawer), unit repeated in every quantity cell with low-contrast grey, type badges with no icon or shape, and no loading, error or first-use states. All rows are two-line (audit table-row-two-line) and the table headers are ALL-CAPS with tracking.
